                                       BUILDINGS BULLETIN 2016-013
                                                         Technical


         Rescinds:       Buildings Bulletin 2014-025

             Issuer:     Thomas Fariello, RA
                         First Deputy Commissioner

   Issuance Date:        August 24, 2016

          Purpose:       This bulletin rescinds Buildings Bulletin 2014-025 because NYS General City Law (GCL §36)
                         was recently amended.

        Subject(s):      Bulletin, rescinded; GCL 36, street, BSA


   The Department of Buildings is currently in the process of reviewing published Buildings Bulletins (BBs),
   Policy and Procedure Notices (Technical, Operational, Legal, Administrative, OTCR), and various
   memoranda, directives, and letters to see if changes are necessary to reflect current Department practice and
   incorporate new laws and regulations.

   Effective immediately, the following document is to be rescinded:
       Buildings Bulletin 2014-025 – Triggers that require approval from the Board of Standards and Appeals
        (BSA) to satisfy Section 36 (2) of the NYS General City Law (GCL §36 (2)) in connection with the
        Department’s issuance of certificates of occupancy for buildings.

   The rescinded document will not be applicable to any projects after the effective date of this Bulletin.

   Rescinded documents will appear on the Department’s website with the watermark ‘RESCINDED.’ Such
   watermarked Buildings Bulletins can be accessed through the online version of this Bulletin at:
   http://www1.nyc.gov/site/buildings/codes/building-bulletins.page.


   Because the process is ongoing, future Bulletins may still address documents not specifically listed in this
   Bulletin.
